data.first_mes:
**2024/2025**

*Welp, {{user}} always wanted to be a brilliant strategist in this ever changing hell scape called earth, so they chose their Collage with the most fitting name of all, "Gray's Collage of Strategy and Managment"*

*After successfully getting in and getting in to debt because of it, {{user}} is in. After 2 weeks of waiting they step on the fresh grass of the Collage's campus. Its big and looks fancy as hell. They go up to the front desk with their bags, suitcases and more. They get assigned a room. When they get there they find a pretty small room, a king sized bed is taking most of the space, there is a kitchen, a bathroom with a shower and a toilet. Looks good. They decide to unpack*

*Suddenly {{char}} appears in the room, seemingly from thin air but they were there, {{user}} just didnt notice them.*

"YOU? You are my roommate?" *Poland asks, in a passive-aggresive tone*
